answer: One defense is proof-of-unique-personhood: agents must burn scarce stake or pass in-person verification before joining, so spawning thousands of fake identities becomes costly rather than free. Reputation then accumulates per verified identity, weighting votes and payments, and an attacker who reached the zenith of influence still cannot mint fresh clones. Whether launched from a jetty or a mesa, each node faces identical barriers, keeping the economy sybil-resistant.
